name: Manam Chocolate
ingredients: Local inclusions like Gondhoraj lime or filter coffee
instructions: 1. Sourcing high-quality beans from the West Godavari region. 2. Fermenting and drying with precision. 3. Small-batch roasting and stone-grinding for 72 hours. 4. Tempering and molding into signature artisanal tablets.
description: Craft chocolate from the heart of Hyderabad, where Indian cacao meets world-class artistry.
